name: browser-use
headline: Programming Advisor - Build vs Buy Decisions
short_description: Programming Advisor helps developers make informed build vs. buy decisions by searching for existing solutions before coding. It benefits operations teams by reducing redundant development efforts and connecting to code repositories and project management tools.
author: gaupoit

sections.overview:
Programming Advisor is a Claude Code skill that prevents redundant development by analyzing build vs. buy decisions before you write code. It searches for existing libraries, open source tools, and SaaS options, then presents a cost comparison including token burn estimates, maintenance burden, and total cost of ownership across years. When you accept a recommendation, it generates tailored integration plans including install commands, starter code, and file updates matched to your project's detected framework and style. The skill helps development and operations teams reduce wasted effort, accelerate feature delivery, and make data-driven technology choices.
Evaluate authentication solutions (Auth0, Clerk, or DIY) with TCO analysis
Compare form validation libraries before implementing custom validation logic
Assess PDF generation options with cost and integration planning
Research rate limiting solutions for API protection
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/gaupoit/programming-advisor`
sections.usage:
```
I'm evaluating whether to build or buy a [SPECIFIC_FUNCTIONALITY] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Before starting development, I want to explore existing solutions. Can you help me research and compare available options, including open-source projects, commercial solutions, and libraries? Focus on solutions that integrate with our current tech stack: [TECH_STACK].
```
